content: 1. Sonidegib metabolism is influenced by hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or consider alternative drugs. 2. St. John's Wort reduces tipranavir levels by increasing its metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 3. Tipranavir increases suvorexant levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. Suvorexant is not recommended with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 4. Tipranavir elevates tacrolimus levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. 5. Tipranavir increases tamsulosin levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 6. Tipranavir raises tazemetostat levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 7. Tipranavir increases temsirolimus levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 8. Tipranavir elevates thioridazine levels by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 9. Tipranavir increases tofacitinib levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. Reduce tofacitinib dose to 5 mg daily when used with potent CYP3A4 inhibitors. 10. Tipranavir raises tolterodine levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 11. Tipranavir increases tolvaptan levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 12. Tovorafenib decreases tipranavir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 13. Tipranavir elevates trabectedin levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. If a strong CYP3A inhibitor is necessary, administer it one week after trabectedin infusion and discontinue it the day before the next infusion. 14. Tipranavir increases trazodone levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 15. Tipranavir raises triazolam levels by decreasing its metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 16. Tipranavir increases trimipramine levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 17. Tucatinib elevates tipranavir levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 18. Tipranavir increases velpatasvir levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 19. Tipranavir raises vemurafenib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 20. Tipranavir increases vilazodone levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase vilazodone plasma levels by 50%; reduce the daily dose to 20 mg. 21. Tipranavir elevates vincristine levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 22. Tipranavir increases vincristine liposomal levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 23. Tipranavir raises vorapaxar levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 24. Voriconazole increases tipranavir levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism, and vice versa. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 25. Tipranavir elevates vortioxetine levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. 26. Tipranavir and abacavir both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Tipranavir decreases abacavir levels through an unspecified mechanism. Use caution and monitor. 27. Tipranavir raises abemaciclib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors increase abemaciclib plasma levels and its metabolites, requiring dose reduction. If the inhibitor is discontinued, increase abemaciclib to the prior dose. 28. Tipranavir reduces acarbose effects through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Use caution and monitor. New-onset or exacerbation of diabetes mellitus and hyperglycemia have been reported with protease inhibitors. 29. Tipranavir decreases albiglutide effects due to insulin resistance. Use caution and monitor. 30. Tipranavir increases alfentanil levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 31. Tipranavir increases amlodipine levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor for potential toxicity. 32. Amobarbital decreases tipranavir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 33. Tipranavir enhances antithrombin alfa effects through pharmacodynamic synergism. Use caution and monitor. Tipranavir has mild antiplatelet activity, increasing bleeding risk. 34. Tipranavir increases antithrombin III effects via pharmacodynamic synergism. Use caution and monitor. 35. Tipranavir raises apalutamide levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Dose reduction may be needed based on tolerability. 36. Tipranavir elevates apixaban levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 37. Aprepitant increases tipranavir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 38. Tipranavir enhances argatroban effects through pharmacodynamic synergism. Use caution and monitor. 39. Armodafinil decreases tipranavir levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 40. Artemether/lumefantrine reduces tipranavir levels via CYP3A4 metabolism, and vice versa. Use caution and monitor. 41. Atazanavir increases tipranavir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor. 42. Tipranavir raises atogepant levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. The recommended atogepant dosage is 10 mg daily when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 43. Tipranavir increases atomoxetine levels by affecting CYP2D6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 44. Tipranavir enhances bemiparin effects through pharmacodynamic synergism. Use caution and monitor. 45. Tipranavir raises benzhydrocodone/acetaminophen levels via CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase hydrocodone plasma concentrations, potentially causing fatal respiratory depression. 46. Tipranavir decreases berotralstat levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 47. Bexarotene reduces tipranavir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism, while tipranavir increases bexarotene levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Use alternatives if available. 48. Tipranavir enhances bivalirudin effects through pharmacodynamic synergism. Use caution and monitor. 49. Tipranavir raises bortezomib levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 50. Bosentan decreases tipranavir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 51. Tipranavir elevates brentuximab vedotin levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor for adverse reactions. 52. Tipranavir increases brexpiprazole levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Administer half the usual brexpiprazole dose with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. If also using a strong/moderate CYP2D6 inhibitor, administer a quarter of the dose. 53. Tipranavir raises bromocriptine levels by decreasing its metabolism, likely due to CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 54. Budesonide reduces tipranavir levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 55. Tipranavir increases buprenorphine levels (including subdermal implant, transdermal, and long-acting injection) via CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Adjust buprenorphine formulations as needed to prevent toxicity or withdrawal. 56. Butabarbital decreases tipranavir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 57. Butalbital reduces tipranavir levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 58. Tipranavir raises cabazitaxel levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Avoid coadministration due to potential toxicity. 59. Tipranavir increases calcifediol levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. CYP450 inhibitors may alter vitamin D metabolism, requiring dose adjustments and monitoring of serum vitamin D, PTH, and calcium levels. 60. Tipranavir elevates cannabidiol levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Consider reducing the cannabidiol dose when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 61. Tipranavir raises capmatinib levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 62. Tipranavir increases carbamazepine levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor plasma levels. 63. Tipranavir elevates cariprazine levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Dose reduction is required with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 64. Tipranavir raises carvedilol levels via CYP2D6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 65. Tipranavir increases chlordiazepoxide levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Consider lowering benzodiazepine doses. 66. Tipranavir increases cholic acid toxicity by reducing its elimination. Modify therapy and monitor closely.
